subject: MAP: POC environment infra checklist & ownership (draft)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment infra checklist & ownership (draft)

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for making time today. Per our discovery call, I’m sending a concise draft of the MAP milestone that covers the POC environment setup dependencies we discussed. This is intended to capture owners and timing so we can unblock provisioning and get the pilot started.

High-level asks (short):
- VPC peering: Acme infra to propose peering CIDR & schedule peering window.
- IP allowlists: Provide list of NAT/public egress IPs or confirm you want Redwood to provide egress via our dedicated IPs.
- SSO/SAML: SAML metadata file + IdP contact for test users.
- Secrets/KMS: Confirm whether you want to use Acme KMS or Redwood-managed KMS for test keys; provide KMS key ARN and KMS admin contact if using Acme.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (milestones + owners), poc-infra-owners.csv (simple owner table).

Proposed milestone timeline (draft):
- Milestone A: Network & peering window — target 2026-05-28 — owner: Acme IT
- Milestone B: SSO metadata exchange & test user setup — target 2026-06-02 — owner: Acme IAM / Redwood SE
- Milestone C: Secrets/KMS access & key policy — target 2026-06-04 — owner: Acme Security / Redwood SecOps

Can you confirm owners and any date constraints on your side? If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min working slot this week to hand off to your infra team.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite if you prefer a live walkthrough.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (summary doc)
Attachment: poc-infra-owners.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment infra checklist & ownership (draft)

Thanks for the clear draft, Ben — good starting point. A few notes from the product/ops side before we lock dates: 

1) Peering windows: we should call out a pre-production and production-like peering option. For initial POC, a single peering window is fine but call out expected CIDR overlap checks and ungefused MTU requirements. I added a short note in the attached CSV (row "network-constraints").

2) IP allowlists: If Acme wants Redwood to egress through our dedicated IP pool, we can provision a static egress IP for the pilot. That requires a signed connectivity SLA addendum — I’ll draft the basic template if they opt in.

3) SAML: We need the IdP metadata plus a test SP entity ID from your side. Karthik, can you list the test accounts we typically provision for POCs so Maya can see the expected attributes?

4) KMS/secrets: For initial validation, Redwood can use customer-managed KMS or a scoped Redwood key. If Acme chooses customer KMS, we need an IAM role ARN and a short key policy allowing Redwood’s provisioning identity to encrypt/decrypt the test keys.

I’ve suggested adjusted dates in the attached CSV. Ben, I’ll sync with you offline and merge any changes before we send the MAP to Acme as "v1 - agreed prerequisites".

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: poc-infra-owners.csv (updated with product/ops notes)
From: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Health IT <it@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment infra checklist & ownership (draft)

Ben / Laura —

Appreciate the concise summary. Quick responses from Acme side: 

- VPC peering: We can do peering but need to avoid 10.0.0.0/8 overlaps. Proposed CIDR for Acme VPC: 172.31.0.0/16. Network can make time for peering window next Tuesday (2026-05-25) afternoon PST. Please confirm what information you need from our network team (route tables, security group IDs, peering acceptance window).

- IP allowlists: We prefer Redwood to egress via our own NAT for compliance. We'll supply egress IPs from our NAT gateway once the peering is in place.

- SSO/SAML: Attached is our IdP metadata file (IdP-metadata-acme.xml) and an IdP contact (it-admin@acmehealth.com). We can publish a test SP entity ID and add attributes once you share the expected schema.

- KMS/secrets: We will use Acme KMS for the pilot. KMS admin: Greg Patel <greg.patel@acmehealth.com>. Greg will share a key ARN and a minimal key policy that allows Redwood's provisioning role to use Encrypt/Decrypt. We need clarification on whether Redwood requires cross-account role assumption or only temporary keys.

Next steps for us: please send a one-page checklist to share with our infra and security teams. If you can turn the MAP draft into an "action lanes" view that maps to our network, IAM, and security owners, that would be ideal.

Thanks —
Maya Lopez
Director, Product Partnerships, Acme Health
maya.lopez@acmehealth.com

Attachment: IdP-metadata-acme.xml (IdP metadata)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment infra checklist & ownership (draft)

Thanks Maya — this is perfect and very helpful. I’ve taken your inputs and prepared an "action lanes" one-pager that maps owners to the three lanes (network, identity, secrets). See attached: poc-infra-setup-ack.pdf (this is a lightweight checklist that your teams can sign off on).

Immediate ask from Redwood:
- Confirm acceptance of the peering window: Tuesday 2026-05-25 13:00-15:00 PST. I’ll put a tentative calendar hold for network contacts.
- Share the KMS key ARN and Greg’s contact (Greg Patel <greg.patel@acmehealth.com>) so our SecOps can prepare a minimal IAM role policy.
- For SAML, please send the test SP entity ID we should expect and any attribute mappings (email, name, role).

Proposed target: If the peering and SAML exchange complete on the dates above, we can have a working POC environment by 2026-06-04 and begin test runs the week of 2026-06-07. Does that timeline work on your side?

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for the peering window and a short 30-min technical handoff meeting this Thursday.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
